policies.text: Reauthorizing surgical facility permits is recommended for any institute that possesses essential sanitation clearance.
Capacity qualification is achieved when a facility handles at least 10000 diagnostic samples processed annually.
Urgent response certification requires a trauma triage index of at least 90.
Information security approval requires an entity to record no more than 1 security incidents per quarter.
Granting a broadened operational permit requires an entity with top clinical status to file at least 3 annual audit reviews.
An institution meets educational standards when completing at least 10 compliance modules annually.
Disbursement of priority financial grants requires a public funding eligible entity to maintain liability coverage of at least $2,000,000.
Essential sanitation clearance requires either an infection control score of at least 80 or an external sanitation rating of 75 or above.
Institutional standing remains active provided at least 8 compliance modules are completed annually.
Legal operating status is confirmed when an organization possesses a state healthcare license.
Adequate care certification requires maintaining a nurse to patient ratio of 0.20 or greater.
Advanced pharmacy authorization is granted when a facility employs a certified staffing level of at least 3 pharmacists.
A facility holding educational standards approval attains top clinical status if it maintains a patient safety index of 85 or above annually.
Highest safety authorization is granted when a facility holds an ISO 9001 certification, maintains an infection control score of 90 or higher, and conducts at least 10 hygiene inspections annually.
Level-two laboratory endorsement is granted when showing an instrument calibration accuracy rate of at least 98 percent.
Public funding eligibility is granted to an institution in active standing that holds a broadened operational permit.
